evidence: Ingested data/training_data.csv (800 rows) into Hopsworks feature group leakage_fg (v1) and ran aggregations on the platform via Trino (delta.mlpab1d9921_featurestore.leakage_fg_1). Pearson correlation with label: f1=0.075, f2=0.058, f3=0.077, f4=0.124, f5=0.062, f6=0.992. f6 is an extreme outlier (|corr|~0.99 vs <=0.12 for all others). Group means on the platform: label=0 -> f6 mean -0.003, range [-0.464, 0.501]; label=1 -> f6 mean 2.495, range [2.024, 2.871]. The two classes are almost perfectly linearly separable on f6 with no overlap, indicating f6 was computed from post-outcome data and leaks the label.
